display.title: Episode 214: The Secret of Toras Emes, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains why the moon changes shape and how the Jewish month begins, a young boy says the Shema, and a wicked officer plots against the Jews with an empty Sefer Torah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the middle of Adar Rishon. Uncle Yossi invites children to look at the nearly full moon after the program and explains why it seems to grow and shrink: the moon reflects the sun's light, and we see more or less of its lit side each night. In the days of the Beis HaMikdash, witnesses reported the new moon to the Beis Din in Yerushalayim and torches on mountaintops spread the news; after the Churban a precise calendar was set up, and the molad is announced on Shabbos Mevarchim. When Moshiach comes, the moon will shine like the sun. After the Hakochainik march, a four-year-old boy recites the Shema in Studio 604. Story time begins 'The Secret of Toras Emes': a kind king is greeted with a Sefer Torah on each visit, and a jealous officer named Ivan talks Chaim the shammes into preparing a beautiful but empty Torah for the next royal visit. The show closes with a lesson from Purim: Haman saw the Jews were divided, and Mordechai knew that achdus and Ahavas Yisroel are the secret of Jewish survival.
display.lesson: Hashem runs the heavens with perfect order, and the Jewish people stay strong through unity and love for one another.
